title: Inside Sink Drainage: How Wastewater Flows From Basin to Stack
description: Sink drainage relies on gravity and proper hydraulic design to carry wastewater safely away from the living space. Understanding how each component works—from the sink strainer and tailpiece to the trap and branch drain—helps professionals ensure smooth, reliable operation. The P-trap plays a crucial role by holding a water seal that prevents sewer gases from entering the building. Meanwhile, proper sloping and venting ensure that water drains efficiently without siphoning the trap seal. Mastering this pathway is fundamental for any plumbing technician working on residential or commercial fixtures.
